title: A bad restriction admits a compatible term
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $\varphi$ be a DNF formula on $n$ sign coordinates, and let $\rho$ be a coordinate restriction. If the restricted Boolean function is nonconstant, then some term of $\varphi$ is compatible with $\rho$, meaning it evaluates to $-1$ on at least one completion of that restriction.
hypotheses_covered: $\varphi$ is a DNF formula on $n$ coordinates
The restricted Boolean function is nonconstant
